body: Sorry, the tempmv.mp4 file is too large to upload .  I will provide it later if need.
Is there any similar merge problem can help?

Hello @byblinkdagger. Thank you for your patience. As far as your queries.

> Q1: I try to merge 2 mp3 files into one file with 2 tracks(one accompany , one voice, in karaoke project). Then i should switch these tracks by myself(not play simultaneously).

Thank you for finding a bug! I tested with your provided media samples and was able to reproduce the issue. The reason that the two 'invalid-switch' mp3 files failed to switch is that the samples had identical [Format](https://exoplayer.dev/doc/reference/com/google/android/exoplayer2/Format.html) values. When trying to selectTracks in `MergingMediaPeriod`, it was unable to differentiate the two tracks. 

I submitted a [fix](https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/commit/ee055ef004686ddb3844666f9506a95c6e16a59f) into dev-v2 that will address the issue.

> Q2: When i play mp4 video files with 2 tracks.

Your attached file did not contain any mp4 files. Would you be able to send them and perhaps a adb bug report? If you're unable to share [bug reports](https://developer.android.com/studio/debug/bug-report) or
test content publicly, please send them to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com using a subject in the format
"Issue #10930". Please also update this issue to
indicate you've done this.

Hi @byblinkdagger,

No problem! Glad that the commit fixed your first issue.

As far as your second issue. When I tested with your provided mp4 file and the Exoplayer sample demo app, the track switched in less than 100-200 ms. More like 1 ms if that. Based on your code, it looks like your app has some button to switch tracks? Would you be able to test with the Exoplayer demo app and see if you hit the same track switch lag issue? You can add the uri of your media sample to media.exolist.json to have it as an option in the demo app.

Furthermore, if you do still hit the issue, can you supply an android adb bug report? If you're unable to share [bug reports](https://developer.android.com/studio/debug/bug-report) or
test content publicly, please send them to dev.exoplayer@gmail.com using a subject in the format
"Issue #10930"
PS: Picture and music will get stuck when you click the switch button frequently for a short time.I have provided a larger mp4 files to to [dev.exoplayer@gmail.com](mailto:dev.exoplayer@gmail.com)
